Structural description is the function of a section intro.

trap-superlative.evidence: Three verbs upgrade conjectures to results in a two-paragraph intro: 'The mass-volume factorisation CONJECTURE ESTABLISHES the categorical mass endomorphism as the product of this topological volume and the Frobenius-packing density'; 'each layer GOVERNED BY the lifted crossing locality CONJECTURE'; 'The jet-tower bound SECURES geometric convergence'. A conjecture cannot establish or govern anything — this is the corpus's own 'conditional-proved is not premise-established' failure mode in miniature, and a section intro is exactly where a reader forms their epistemic picture of what follows.
trap-superlative.notes: Proposed: 'The mass-volume factorisation conjecture WOULD IDENTIFY the categorical mass endomorphism with the product ...'; 'each layer CONJECTURALLY governed by ...'; 'The jet-tower bound GIVES geometric convergence' (if proved) or 'is conjectured to give'. Structural because it changes the epistemic status the intro asserts, so it needs the author's confirmation of which of the three are proved.
